prompt: Read a|b. Print TIE if equal; otherwise print the smaller number plus 1.
target:

SENTENCE line.
INPUT(line).

NUMBER a = strings.TO_NUMBER(parts[0]).
NUMBER b = strings.TO_NUMBER(parts[1]).

prompt: Read n; sum values 1..n divisible by 2 but not by 3.
target:
NUMBER n.
INPUT(n).
NUMBER total=0.
LOOP (NUMBER i=1 TILL i<=n, i++) { IF (i%2==0 AND i%3!=0) { total+=i. } }
DISPLAYNL(total).

prompt: Read n, compute n!, and print BIG1 if it exceeds 20, else SMALL1.
Read four numbers into an array; sum positive values and add 1.
target:
IMPORT strings.
SENTENCE line.
INPUT(line).
SENTENCE[] parts = strings.SPLIT(line, "|").
NUMBER a = strings.TO_NUMBER(parts[0]).
NUMBER b = strings.TO_NUMBER(parts[1]).
NUMBER c = strings.TO_NUMBER(parts[2]).
NUMBER d = strings.TO_NUMBER(parts[3]).
NUMBER[] values=[a,b,c,d].
NUMBER total=1.
LOOP (NUMBER i=0 TILL i<4, i++) { IF (values[i]>0) { total+=values[i]. } }
DISPLAYNL(total).

prompt: Read text; lowercase it and print LONG1 if length is at least 5, else the lowercase text.
target:
IMPORT strings.
SENTENCE text.
INPUT(text).
SENTENCE low=strings.LOWER(text).
IF (strings.LENGTH(low)>=5) { DISPLAYNL("LONG1"). } ELSE { DISPLAYNL(low). }

prompt: Define a function returning x*x+1; read n and sum the function over 1..n.
target:
FUNCTION term(NUMBER x) { RETURN x*x+1. } RETURNS NUMBER.
NUMBER n.
INPUT(n).
NUMBER total=0.
LOOP (NUMBER i=1 TILL i<=n, i++) { total+=term(i). }
DISPLAYNL(total).
